favoritesEmpty: No favorites yet, click the star on a tool page to add one
crashDescription: The app hit an unexpected error. Your data lives on this device and is not lost — reloading usually fixes it.

lightbox.title: Lightbox view
lightbox.hint: Scroll to zoom · drag to pan · double-click to magnify · click outside the image to close

ai.entryHint: When off, the polish and proofreading entries are hidden and Import PDF is greyed out. When on, content goes straight to the provider you configure here.

config.title: AI provider settings
config.pickHint: Configure several providers; pick one to edit it here.
config.notice: The key stays in this browser local storage and requests go straight from your browser to the address you set. This site neither proxies nor stores it.
config.baseUrlHint: You can point this at your own relay. Use https (http only for localhost); a wrong address means the request never lands.
config.modelPlaceholder: Type a model name, e.g. deepseek-chat
config.textHint: Each provider keeps its own text, vision, image and reverse-vision pick, so configuring one never overwrites another. The provider that actually runs is the one chosen at the top. The vision slot feeds PDF import, the reverse-vision slot feeds prompt reverse-engineering, and the image slot only applies to OpenAI / Gemini.
config.directBlocked: This provider has no CORS enabled: the browser will block the request, so both "Fetch models" and later calls fail. Use a CORS-enabled relay address instead.
config.fetchEmpty: That endpoint returned no models. Use "Type a model name" and fill it in.
config.listEmpty: Start with "Fetch models" at the top right. If that endpoint is unsupported, choose "Type a model name" and fill it in.

test.mismatch: The reply did not match what was expected
test.canvasUnavailable: This browser cannot create a canvas, so the vision check is unavailable

consent.title: Turn on AI assist?
consent.body: Once on, polishing, proofreading and PDF import send your resume content directly to the provider you configured, never through this site. Resume text is personal information; make sure you accept that.

errors.configRequired: Missing API key or model name.
errors.invalidEndpoint: The endpoint URL is not valid.
errors.corsBlocked: The request never left the browser: this endpoint likely blocks cross-origin calls, or is unreachable from here. Use a CORS-enabled relay address instead.
errors.authenticationFailed: The API key is invalid or expired.
errors.modelAccessDenied: This key has no access to that model.
errors.requestTooLarge: The payload exceeds the request size limit.
errors.modelOrEndpointError: The model name or endpoint does not exist.
errors.truncatedOutput: The model output was cut off by the length limit; shorten the input and retry.
errors.refused: The model refused to process this content.
errors.invalidOutput: The model response could not be parsed; try again.
errors.pdfUnreadable: This PDF could not be read.
errors.encryptedPdf: The PDF is encrypted and cannot be imported.
